subject: CSEK and cross-region key-wrapping evidence for AerisBank SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@aerisbk.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AerisBank SOC2 intake - CSEK / cross-region wrapping artifacts

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. AerisBank's security team is kicking off a focused review of encryption controls as part of our SOC2 intake and we've got a couple of specific asks related to customer-supplied encryption keys (CSEK) and cross-region key wrapping. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports: 1) customer-managed keys (CSEK) for private deployments, 2) deterministic rewrap traces when we replicate wrapped keys across regions, and 3) sampling of rotation logs that include key IDs, rotation timestamps, and the wrapping algorithm used?

If possible, we'd like a short evidence bundle (CSV manifest + sample logs) and a pointer to the runbook that covers emergency rewrap and rekey procedures. Our audit window is tight — can you share what you can by end of day Monday?

Cheers,
Kyle
Security Engineer, AerisBank

--
AerisBank Security Intake
attachment: aeris-soc2-encrypt-checklist.xlsx (ref)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@aerisbk.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AerisBank SOC2 intake - CSEK / cross-region wrapping artifacts

Hi Kyle — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes on CSEK for Private deployments, yes on providing rewrap traces for cross-region replication, and yes on rotation log samples. I'm looping in Marissa (KeyOps runbooks) and Ben (audit log extraction) to pull the artifacts and confirm acceptable formats.

Planned deliverables:
- CSV manifest listing object-level wrapped-key metadata (key_id, wrapped_with, wrap_algo, region, last_rotated)
- A tarball with 2 rotation log samples (an automated rotation and an emergency manual rewrap) redacted for PII
- Runbook excerpt (BYOK/CSEK emergency rewrap, minimal privileges checklist)

Marissa / Ben: can you prepare the items below and drop them to the Drive link? We will include a short README explaining what fields are pseudonymized.

Kyle — one question: do you need HSM attestation (e.g., vendor cert) or just the operational artifacts? Let me know and we'll add it.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Security Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwoodinference.com

--
attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AerisBank SOC2 intake - CSEK / cross-region wrapping artifacts

Thanks Jasmine — will do. Quick clarification for the deliverable format so Kyle's team can index it easily:

1) CSV manifest columns: key_id, key_type, wrap_algo, wrapping_kms_id, wrapped_region, created_at_iso, last_rotated_iso, exportable_flag, note
2) Rotation logs: will include a minimal header per event with event_id, key_id, operator_principal, operation_type (scheduled|manual|emergency), old_wrapper, new_wrapper, timestamp_iso, correlation_id. We'll pseudonymize operator_principal and correlation_id.
3) Runbook: provide a short PDF excerpt (2 pages) describing the emergency rewrap steps and post-rewrap validation checks (integrity checks, service restart plan).

I'm attaching the intake manifest we plan to send and a sample rotation tarball index in the Drive. Ben — can you pull the actual log samples from the rotation archive and scrub operator principals? Prefer retaining original timestamps.

Marissa Cole
Key Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

--
attachment: redwood-byok-runbook-v2.pdf (excerpt), aeris_kms_evidence_manifest.csv (draft)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AerisBank SOC2 intake - CSEK / cross-region wrapping artifacts

All — artifacts uploaded to shared Drive folder and to the HubSpot ticket (HS-89123). Summary of what's included:

- aeris_kms_evidence_manifest.csv (CSV) — contains 1,250 wrapped-key metadata rows (sampled to show cross-region replication patterns).
- rotation-sample-202805.tgz (tarball) — contains two JSON log files: rotation-202805-automatic.json and rotation-202805-emergency.json. Each file includes event-level entries with key_id, operation_type, timestamp_iso, old_wrapper_kms, new_wrapper_kms, and wrap_algo (RSA-OAEP-256 / AES-GCM-wrapped). Operator principals have been pseudonymized to op_xxx.
- redwood-byok-runbook-v2.pdf (excerpt) — 2 pages covering emergency rewrap, validations (SHA256 digest checks), and operator separation of duty.

Also included a short README.txt describing redaction approach and the mapping that remains available under NDA. If AerisBank wants HSM vendor attestation, we can provide the vendor cert+attestation PDF (HSM-vendor-attest-2027.pdf) under an NDA.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3CseEvidencePack
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/tickets/89123
